title: King Oliver kept to himself and scolded the band for smoking pot
summary: Oliver didn't socialise or drink and told his players that marijuana made them think they played well.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Correct me if this is wrong. I just heard that he didn't hang out with a lot of the younger guys. He wasn't too close to the real younger musicians.
No, he didn't never hang out with nobody.
Anything you could tell about his personality would be...

Yeah. He didn't hang out with nobody. He always stayed to himself. I mean, he'd go out. But he didn't drink, he didn't do nothing like that. So he wasn't like the cats, drinking and smoking a little pot and all of that.

No. He used to give us hell for smoking. He'd say, "You all get full of that shit and think you're playing something. You ain't playing a damn thing!" He used to tell the guys that. He said, "You'all sho played sad last night." And we thought we'd played like hell. He said, "You think you played something. That stuff make you think you're doing something when you ain't doin' nothin'."
